evidence.reason: In recheck_baseline, the post-drain preserved digests replace self.preserved, but the only recorded checkpoint at line 870 records sorted key names, not the digest values, so the durable receipt remains the pre-drain one. If the process dies after recheck_baseline and before/during the switch, the in-memory post-drain baseline is lost and an operator cannot verify whether the switch preserved the bytes actually present when it began. This is a crash-consistency bug in the runbook's existing recovery evidence, not a request for new scope.
